compilation.method: Untouched generated function included in a full physical warp kernel wrapper; only lanes zero through eighteen call it

compiledPtxSymbolicCheck.method: Interpret actual compiled PTX integer controls, predicates, collective shuffles and symbolic input contribution vectors; reject unsupported instructions

scope: Compilation and symbolic instruction checks, without source edits. FP32 rounding is not simulated; the public problem permits any addition order. No NVIDIA hardware execution was performed. This is selective code validation, not a whole-interview accuracy certificate.
